aiTask: Document understanding and structured information extraction from borehole profile PDFs
inputSpecification:
PDF files:

Documents containing borehole profiles / logs
Digital or scanned with OCR already applied
outputSpecification:
JSON, structured geological data including:

Metadata (coordinates, borehole name, elevation...)
Lithological layers (depths and corresponding descriptions)
Groundwater measurements
